# Grid

Bring continuity and consistency across all screens of the same application.
See [Grid guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/visual-styles/grid/)

The `ds-row-*` and `ds-col-*` classes, used together, unleash the full power of our 12-column grid system.
It allows a lot of flexibility in terms of responsive layouts.

See the supported <LinkTo kind="General/Layout/Introduction" story="docs">breakpoints</LinkTo>

As the grid utilities are bases on flexbox, you can use our <LinkTo kind="Components/Flex" story="docs">Flex utilities</LinkTo>

<Canvas of={GridStories.Basic} />

```css
.grid-demo [class*="ds-col"] {
  background-color: #f0f4f6;
  border: 1px solid rgba(86, 61, 124, 0.2);
  padding: 1rem;
}
```

## Examples

#### Column classes

| Class name                                | Usage                                                                             |
| ----------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ds-col                                    | equal width (for all columns in a row)                                            |
| ds-col-auto                               | variable width (adapting to column content)                                       |
| ds-col-`{breakpoint}`                     | equal width - starting at minimum breakpoint                                      |
| ds-col-`{breakpoint}`-auto                | variable width - starting at minimum breakpoint                                   |
| ds-col-`{numberOfColumns}`                | width calculated from specified number of column                                  |
| ds-col-`{breakpoint}`-`{numberOfColumns}` | width calculated from specified number of column - starting at minimum breakpoint |

#### Column order classes

| Class name                           | Usage                                                        |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| ds-order-first                       | reorder as the first column (applying order: -1)             |
| ds-order-last                        | reorder as the last column (applying order: 6)               |
| ds-order-`{priority}`                | reorder column by priority (from 0 to 5)                     |
| ds-order-`{breakpoint}`-first        | reorder as the first column - starting at minimum breakpoint |
| ds-order-`{breakpoint}`-last         | reorder as the last column - starting at minimum breakpoint  |
| ds-order-`{breakpoint}`-`{priority}` | reorder column by priority - starting at minimum breakpoint  |

#### Column offset classes

| Class name                                   | Usage                                                                   |
| -------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ds-offset-`{numberOfColumns}`                | offset from specified number of column (from 0 to 11)                   |
| ds-offset-`{breakpoint}`-`{numberOfColumns}` | offset from specified number of column - starting at minimum breakpoint |
